_comment: The tariff catalogue the stand configures on BOTH halves of the
differential, before the purchase. Squads are named, not pinned: a
@-prefixed string is resolved by seed_tariffs.py against the squads the
shop can actually see on whichever panel it is pointed at, because the two
panels issue their own uuids and a catalogue with the other half's uuids
would fail inside the shop and never reach the panel at all.
Two tariffs, arranged so the admin walkthrough moves squads in both
directions: `standard` (bought) carries the premium squad, `pro` does not,
so switching standard->pro is a squad REMOVAL - the direction where a
status-gated or add-only implementation quietly does nothing.
